items.label: Quartz Ladies Watch
items.value: Imported quartz movement and durable high-quality battery keep perfect time. Make sure that every movement of the hour hand is accurately timed.

items.label: Fashion Ladies Watch
items.value: Small size watch specially designed for women, the simple design exudes noble temperament, with easy-to-read digital dial, the compact and simple design endows the whole with femininity.

items.label: Women's waterproof watch
items.value: Water-resistant to 30 meters, it can withstand daily splashes, but it is not suitable for swimming. Luminous hands and hour markers let you easily keep track of the time at night.

items.label: A GREAT GIFT FOR WOMEN
items.value: Elegant and stylish OLEVS watch is your best choice. It's the perfect gift idea for Weddings, Anniversaries, Birthdays, Parties, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas and more.
